emails.subject: Follow-up: Vendor evaluation list & Q4 procurement
emails.body: Hi Arjun, following up on our sync earlier today. We really need the finalized vendor evaluation list to sign off on our Q4 tech stack. Please let me know when you can send this over.

thread.body: Hi Raghav, understood. I will review the commercial terms and send the updated vendor list to you by Wednesday morning without delay.

emails.subject: Q3 Enterprise Sales Deck
emails.body: Hi Raghav, I am putting final touches on the slide numbers. I will share the finalized Q3 Enterprise Sales deck with you today by 5:00 PM so you have it ahead of tomorrow's product review.

emails.subject: RE: Enterprise discount approval for Zenith Corp
emails.body: Hi Arjun, regarding your request for a 25% custom discount on the Zenith Corp 3-year contract: I am running the margin impact model with the CFO today. I will send you the final discount approval decision by Thursday 3:00 PM.

emails.subject: Urgent: CRM duplicate lead audit needed
emails.body: Team, we noticed severe duplication in incoming Enterprise leads across West and South territories. Someone needs to audit duplicate CRM lead records and update territory mapping before end of week. Please coordinate internally.

emails.subject: Apex Tech Renewal Presentation - Schedule Change
emails.body: Hi Arjun, the client contact at Apex Tech just reached out requesting to reschedule our annual renewal presentation to Thursday at 2:00 PM due to a board meeting conflict on Friday. Please update your prep accordingly.

emails.subject: Speaker invitation: APAC Tech Summit next month
emails.body: Hi Arjun, the organizers of the APAC Tech Summit asked if you would be open to delivering a 20-minute keynote on Enterprise AI Sales on Nov 12. Let me know if you would like me to put your name forward.

emails.subject: Intro: Acme Corp procurement team
emails.body: Hi Karthik, as promised during Monday's standup, I have just sent over the warm intro email connecting you with the Acme Corp procurement lead. All done on my end.

meeting_transcripts.title: Executive Leadership Sync
transcript: Vikram: Good morning team. Let's run through key deliverables for this week.
Raghav: On product procurement, Arjun, we need the updated vendor list to lock in our Q4 tooling contracts. When can you deliver it?
Arjun: I am reviewing the final supplier pricing today. I agreed to send the updated vendor list to Raghav by Wednesday morning.
Vikram: Good. Arjun, where do we stand on the Enterprise Q3 headcount budget proposal? HR needs that urgently.
Arjun: I will submit the finalized Enterprise Q3 headcount budget proposal to you and HR by yesterday Tuesday at 4:00 PM.
Priya: Great. Also, regarding the Acme Corp annual renewal agreement, legal gave the final sign-off.
Arjun: Perfect. I will review and sign the Acme Corp renewal contract today by 5:00 PM.
Vikram: Excellent, let's keep the momentum.

meeting_transcripts.title: Product-Sales Alignment Review
transcript: Arjun: Raghav, our enterprise clients are asking about the new API endpoints before committing to annual renewals.
Raghav: Understood Arjun. I will share the Q4 API Roadmap draft with Arjun by Thursday 12:00 PM so you can share it with tier-1 accounts.
Dev Lead: Also team, we noticed our sales stage definitions in Salesforce are completely out of sync with engineering delivery stages.
Sales Ops: Yes, we need someone to fix the inconsistent sales stage definitions in Salesforce before next month's forecast.
Arjun: We should address that soon. Let's table who handles it for the ops review.
